8980.title: Shrine
8980.info: Shrines are small dungeons scattered throughout Hyrule. Interact with one to unlock a Fast Travel point, and then complete the challenge inside to grant a Light of Blessing.

8983.title: Goddess Statue
8983.info: Pray at Goddess Statues to increase Link's maximum health or stamina. Each stat upgrade requires 4 x Light of Blessings.

8984.title: Great Fairy
8984.info: Great Fairies will improve armor in exchange for materials and rupees. To achieve higher enhancement levels, you must unlock additional Great Fairies.

8999.title: Hestu
8999.info: Hestu will expand your maximum inventory capacity in exchange for Korok Seeds.

9005.title: Weapon
9005.info: Weapons found in the overworld might be of a higher tier, depending on your game's progress.

9006.title: Shield
9006.info: Shields are used by Link to defens against enemy attacks. Shields found in the overworld and chests might be of a higher tier, depending on your game's progress.

9012.title: Rupees
9012.info:
Hyrule's currency; value determined by colour.
Green = 1; Blue = 5; Red = 20; Purple = 50; Silver = 100; Gold = 300

9013.title: Koltin
9013.info: Only appearing at night, Koltin's shop offers unique items in exchange for Bubbul Gems.

9018.title: Side Quest
9018.info: Optional quests, given by NPCs throughout Hyrule. Look for small red exclamation marks (!) under their dialogue.

9020.title: Memory
9020.info: Memories are short, lore-related cutscenes. They are obtained from Dragon Tears or, sometimes, story-related events.

9021.title: Side Adventure
9021.template:
**Previous Side Adventure:** ??  

**How To Begin:** ??  

**Reward:** ??

**Next Side Adventure:** ??

9029.title: Enemy Camp
9029.info:
Enemy Camps are locations filled with enemies guarding a single locked or open chest.  

Enemies are progress-dependent

9047.title: Octorok
9047.info:
All Rock Octoroks have a random chance to spawn at these locations.

Drop a weapon in front of a Rock Octorock; it will absorb the weapon and spit it back out, repaired and with a random bonus. Works once per Octorock, but resets with Blood Moons.

9048.title: Hudson Sign
9048.info: Hudson Signs are signposts that Addison tries to scatter across Hyrule. Use the nearby materials to build a free-standing structure that supports the sign. His rewards are random.

9049.title: Lightroot
9049.info: Interact with Lightroots to illuminate the Depths and create Fast Travel spots.

9051.title: Paraglider Fabric
9051.info: Unlocks new customization options at Dye Shops for Link's paraglider.

9052.title: Voice Memory
9052.info:
Voice Memories are optional content exclusive to the Switch 2 version of the game.  
To collect them, connect your game with the Nintendo Switch app on your mobile device, then open the Zelda Notes section. Once you approach this location in-game, the Voice Memory will be collected and play on your mobile device.

9061.title: Cave
9061.info: Caves are hidden, underground tunnels. Each contains various materials, chests and a single Bubbulfrog.

9062.title: Falling Platform
9062.info: Use the Recall skill on these platforms that fall from the clouds to ride them up to the Sky

9063.title: Well
9063.info: Wells are hidden, underground areas. They often contain resources and other precious materials.

9064.title: Bargainer Statue
9064.info: Bargainer Statues are special vendors whose inventory expands as you discover more of them.

9066.title: Dragon Tear
9066.info: Dragon Tears can be found after completing [Impa and the Geoglyphs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276885). Scan the geoglyph from above, then search it for the Dragon Tear, which should yield a Memory.

9070.title: Lighthouse
9070.info: Use ascend while standing underneath it to return to the Surface

9075.title: Satori Tree
9075.info: Offer a piece of fruit at the altar under the cherry-blossom trees and the Horse God will highlight caves on the map for you.

9076.title: Korok Seed
9076.info: Korok Seeds are hidden everywhere on Hyrule and the Sky Islands. Bring them to Hestu to expand your inventory.

9078.title: Key Item
9078.info: Key Items are unique items scattered through Hyrule. They are often obtained or awarded through main quests, and are required to progress through the game.
